declared_cohort: Fixed 40 individual single-course 2025 PGA TOUR editions from reports/golf-weather-group-inventory-2026-09-14.json; no scoring or weather comparisons used for selection.
coordinate_selection: Human-reviewed named golf polygon representative point, or a map embedded by the official club at its identified address; never a city center. OSM combined properties spanning multiple nearest 0.25-degree GFS cells are ambiguous and excluded until a subcourse position is verified.
ambiguous_definition: True means no defensible position for the declared venue at the weather-grid resolution; such rows are ineligible. False can still be a golf-property centroid or official clubhouse/map-center position, as explicitly described by quality and coordinate_scope.
geometry_limit: OSM was queried in September2026 and is not a historical geometry snapshot. Official2025 PGA course identities choose the venue; weather point is a static representative position, not a historical tee location.
attribution: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL1.0: https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright . Official embedded maps are attributed to their club pages / Google Maps.
collection_method: Single-machine, single-thread, one-time bounded named-course queries; identifying application User-Agent; 2 seconds between requests; cached each response, no recurring service. Stopped PGA.com after one403 fallback; did not retry it.
